units.rawText: Ladies and gentlemen! We now bring you the third match of the Wishing Fist Tournament's F Block qualifying bouts!
units.displayText: Ladies and gentlemen! We now bring you the third match of the Wishing Fist Tournament's F Block qualifying bouts!

spans.text: Ladies and gentlemen! We now bring you the third match of the Wishing Fist Tournament's F Block qualifying bouts!

units.rawText: Over the course of the past three rounds, our contestant in the blue corner has gained the advantage of 1 point! Meanwhile, the red corner is still eager to fight...
units.displayText: Over the course of the past three rounds, our contestant in the blue corner has gained the advantage of 1 point! Meanwhile, the red corner is still eager to fight...

spans.text: Over the course of the past three rounds, our contestant in the blue corner has gained the advantage of 1 point! Meanwhile, the red corner is still eager to fight...

units.rawText: Magnhilda leans against the ropes and studies the opponent before her.
units.displayText: Magnhilda leans against the ropes and studies the opponent before her.

spans.text: Magnhilda leans against the ropes and studies the opponent before her.

units.rawText: He wears a pair of red gloves and is currently playing to the crowd. His face could not be any more familiar—after all, he had been badmouthing her in the boxing gym just a few days ago.
units.displayText: He wears a pair of red gloves and is currently playing to the crowd. His face could not be any more familiar—after all, he had been badmouthing her in the boxing gym just a few days ago.

spans.text: He wears a pair of red gloves and is currently playing to the crowd. His face could not be any more familiar—after all, he had been badmouthing her in the boxing gym just a few days ago.

units.rawText: Fate has a way of bringing enemies together...
units.displayText: Fate has a way of bringing enemies together...

spans.text: Fate has a way of bringing enemies together...

units.rawText: She sighs and then quickly glances over the audience offstage.
units.displayText: She sighs and then quickly glances over the audience offstage.

spans.text: She sighs and then quickly glances over the audience offstage.

units.rawText: The venue is brightly lit, with cameras of all shapes and sizes everywhere, and brilliantly dressed staff. This place could not be any more different from the underground fighting rings hidden in abandoned factories.
units.displayText: The venue is brightly lit, with cameras of all shapes and sizes everywhere, and brilliantly dressed staff. This place could not be any more different from the underground fighting rings hidden in abandoned factories.

spans.text: The venue is brightly lit, with cameras of all shapes and sizes everywhere, and brilliantly dressed staff. This place could not be any more different from the underground fighting rings hidden in abandoned factories.

units.rawText: The only thing these two places have in common is the passion of the audience.
units.displayText: The only thing these two places have in common is the passion of the audience.

spans.text: The only thing these two places have in common is the passion of the audience.

units.rawText: Go! Get 'em!
units.displayText: Go! Get 'em!

spans.text: Go! Get 'em!

units.rawText: Enough lazing around! Get to it already!
units.displayText: Enough lazing around! Get to it already!

spans.text: Enough lazing around! Get to it already!

units.rawText: Show that Doll what for!
units.displayText: Show that Doll what for!

spans.text: Show that Doll what for!

units.rawText: Heard that, trash?
units.displayText: Heard that, trash?

spans.text: Heard that, trash?

units.rawText: Everyone's eager to see me take you apart. Want to play along with me like usual?
units.displayText: Everyone's eager to see me take you apart. Want to play along with me like usual?

spans.text: Everyone's eager to see me take you apart. Want to play along with me like usual?

units.rawText: Magnhilda slowly raises her fists.
units.displayText: Magnhilda slowly raises her fists.

spans.text: Magnhilda slowly raises her fists.

units.rawText: Why don't you concentrate on counting how many teeth you'll have left?
units.displayText: Why don't you concentrate on counting how many teeth you'll have left?

spans.text: Why don't you concentrate on counting how many teeth you'll have left?

units.rawText: Ohhh! Both sides are ready to clash once again!
units.displayText: Ohhh! Both sides are ready to clash once again!

spans.text: Ohhh! Both sides are ready to clash once again!

units.rawText: Round 4—ready, go!
units.displayText: Round 4—ready, go!

spans.text: Round 4—ready, go!

units.rawText: Bam!
units.displayText: Bam!

spans.text: Bam!

units.rawText: Her opponent closes the gap with a sliding step, and attacks pour down on her like rain.
units.displayText: Her opponent closes the gap with a sliding step, and attacks pour down on her like rain.

spans.text: Her opponent closes the gap with a sliding step, and attacks pour down on her like rain.

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: Magnhilda barely manages to adjust her stance and block her opponent's offensive.
units.displayText: Magnhilda barely manages to adjust her stance and block her opponent's offensive.

spans.text: Magnhilda barely manages to adjust her stance and block her opponent's offensive.

units.rawText: A little slow on the startup, eh? Trash!
units.displayText: A little slow on the startup, eh? Trash!

spans.text: A little slow on the startup, eh? Trash!

units.rawText: (I can't keep up with his speed... Is this an aftereffect from the previous fight?)
units.displayText: I can't keep up with his speed... Is this an aftereffect from the previous fight?

spans.text: I can't keep up with his speed... Is this an aftereffect from the previous fight?

units.rawText: (I DID refuse repairs, after all...)
units.displayText: I DID refuse repairs, after all...

spans.text: I DID refuse repairs, after all...

units.rawText: Magnhilda has not undergone any maintenance ever since the previous match.
units.displayText: Magnhilda has not undergone any maintenance ever since the previous match.

spans.text: Magnhilda has not undergone any maintenance ever since the previous match.

units.rawText: (It's alright...)
units.displayText: It's alright...

spans.text: It's alright...

units.rawText: (I just need to shift my stance to compensate for my lack of coordination...)
units.displayText: I just need to shift my stance to compensate for my lack of coordination...

spans.text: I just need to shift my stance to compensate for my lack of coordination...

units.rawText: Alert, arms are taking hits... Risk of damage increasing...
units.displayText: Alert, arms are taking hits... Risk of damage increasing...

spans.text: Alert, arms are taking hits... Risk of damage increasing...

units.rawText: You can take a good pounding, can't you, tin can?
units.displayText: You can take a good pounding, can't you, tin can?

spans.text: You can take a good pounding, can't you, tin can?

units.rawText: (Got to hang in there... I'm sure he'll show an opening eventually...)
units.displayText: Got to hang in there... I'm sure he'll show an opening eventually...

spans.text: Got to hang in there... I'm sure he'll show an opening eventually...

units.rawText: (If I just aim for that moment...)
units.displayText: If I just aim for that moment...

spans.text: If I just aim for that moment...

units.rawText: Come on! You can do it!
units.displayText: Come on! You can do it!

spans.text: Come on! You can do it!

units.rawText: Quit hiding and FIGHT!
units.displayText: Quit hiding and FIGHT!

spans.text: Quit hiding and FIGHT!

units.rawText: Get him! Get him!
units.displayText: Get him! Get him!

spans.text: Get him! Get him!

units.rawText: The audience's cries thunder through her eardrums like they always do.
units.displayText: The audience's cries thunder through her eardrums like they always do.

spans.text: The audience's cries thunder through her eardrums like they always do.

units.rawText: Warning, risk of arm damage rising to 60%... Core temperature rising...
units.displayText: Warning, risk of arm damage rising to 60%... Core temperature rising...

spans.text: Warning, risk of arm damage rising to 60%... Core temperature rising...

units.rawText: This doesn't feel scripted in the least. Even though her body is heavy, Magnhilda feels everything binding her fists begin to loosen up and fall away.
units.displayText: This doesn't feel scripted in the least. Even though her body is heavy, Magnhilda feels everything binding her fists begin to loosen up and fall away.

spans.text: This doesn't feel scripted in the least. Even though her body is heavy, Magnhilda feels everything binding her fists begin to loosen up and fall away.

units.rawText: (So this is what they call... the "Wishing Fist"...)
units.displayText: So this is what they call... the "Wishing Fist"...

spans.text: So this is what they call... the "Wishing Fist"...

units.rawText: This... is the battlefield I've longed for!
units.displayText: This... is the battlefield I've longed for!

spans.text: This... is the battlefield I've longed for!

units.rawText: Magnhilda takes aim at the weakness her eyes have spotted and launches a fierce punch at it.
units.displayText: Magnhilda takes aim at the weakness her eyes have spotted and launches a fierce punch at it.

spans.text: Magnhilda takes aim at the weakness her eyes have spotted and launches a fierce punch at it.

units.displayText: BAM!
